source: RFC 0006 §9.5; usability review UD-7, UD-11 (maintainer's decisions, 2026-11-19)
statement: Every output names what decided in the decision event's words (`outcome.reason`): the span as they are, the metrics' `result` in lower case, audit's `decision` in upper case, each through one exhaustive mapping. An explicit deny (`explicit_deny`, `EXPLICIT_DENY`) is only a request a DENY statement refused; a scope rejection, a boundary refusal and a `400` each have their own value, and a permit is `permit`/`PERMIT`. The event's `subject.method` is the credential's method as `CoSec-Identity` names it (`jwt`, `api-key`, or another verifier's name).
guards: runtime:AuditVocabularyTest#every reason has the audit decision of its own name
micrometer:ResultVocabularyTest#every reason has the result of its own name
runtime:SubjectMethodTest#the event names the credential as the identity header does
